findings.evidence: `upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearMap.lean:528: protected abbrev BilinForm : Type _ := LinearMap.BilinMap R M R`; `upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/Properties.lean:138: lemma IsSymm.polarization`; upstream names for the same statement: `upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Basic.lean:253: theorem inner_add_add_self` and `:264: theorem inner_sub_sub_self`. The diff's own call sites write `Bilin.apply_add_self g hg` fully qualified, never `g.apply_add_self`.
findings.fix: Move both to `namespace LinearMap.BilinForm` (or `LinearMap.BilinForm.IsSymm`, beside `IsSymm.polarization`) and rename after upstream: `add_add_self` and `sub_sub_self`, where the doubled operation records that both slots carry the sum/difference.
findings.issue: `Bilin.apply_add_self` and `Bilin.apply_sub_self` (lines 37 and 42) are general facts about a Mathlib type, not EpsilonEridani notions: `Bilin V` is an `abbrev` for `LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V`, and the first explicit argument `g` is one, so they belong in the `LinearMap.BilinForm` namespace (where Mathlib keeps `IsSymm.polarization`). As declared they are unreachable by dot notation and cannot be upstreamed without renaming. The names also deviate from the upstream name for exactly this identity.

findings.evidence: New `noncomputable def xi (g : Bilin V) (K : DisKinematics V)` at Diffractive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:97 vs `noncomputable def xiSkew` at Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:76 ("Skewness `ξ = -Δ·qbar / (2 Pbar·qbar)`").
findings.fix: Rename to the literature-standard qualified form, e.g. `xiPom` or `xIP` (the docstring already says this is "the `x_IP` of the diffraction literature"), matching the `xiSkew` precedent; update `xi_def`, `xi_eq_one_sub_div`, `xi_congr`, `xi_eq_Q2_add_MX2_sub_tMom_div` and `xBj_eq_xi_mul_beta` accordingly.
findings.issue: `xi` is an unqualified ξ while the sibling exclusive layer already defines a different ξ of the same event as `ExclKinematics.xiSkew`; the docstring has to warn "Despite the shared symbol `ξ`, this is not `ExclKinematics.xiSkew`", which is evidence the name itself does not distinguish them. The repo's precedent is to qualify ξ by what it measures.

findings.evidence: Diffractive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:72-73 `def deltaTarget (K : DisKinematics V) : V := K.p - K.pPrime` vs Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:64-65 `def delta (K : ExclKinematics V) : V := K.pPrime - K.p`; the diff records the clash itself in `delta_toExclKinematics : (toExclKinematics K phiL phiH).delta = -deltaTarget K` (line 187).
findings.fix: Give the name the direction it fixes, e.g. `deltaLost` (the documented "momentum lost by the target") or `pSubPPrime`, and rename the dependent lemmas (`deltaTarget_def`, `apply_deltaTarget_left`/`_right`, `delta_toExclKinematics`, `deltaTarget_congr`, the `MX2_eq_…`/`MY2_eq_…` names) to match.
findings.issue: `deltaTarget = P - P'` carries the opposite sign to `ExclKinematics.delta = P' - P`, and the name gives no cue of the direction — only the docstring does. A consumer who knows `delta` will read `deltaTarget` as "the `delta` of the target" and get the wrong sign in every Δ-linear result, e.g. `MY2_eq_p_sq_sub_two_mul_apply_p_deltaTarget_add_tMom` and `apply_deltaTarget_left`/`_right`.

summary: Two generic symmetric-bilinear-form lemmas are filed in EpsilonEridani's `Bilin` namespace rather than Mathlib's `LinearMap.BilinForm`, and under names that deviate from the upstream name for the same identity. Two diffractive names collide semantically with sibling declarations: a bare `xi` next to `ExclKinematics.xiSkew`, and `deltaTarget` carrying the opposite sign to `ExclKinematics.delta`.
